reviewTitle: Soft shell and great quality - Still lovely after 1 year of extensive travel
reviewDescription: Since 1 year I have been using this for my iPad pro: It is wonderful! Soft shell and while slightly too large for the iPad pro - it allows be to include a small notepad/paper and pen. It has travelled extensively and after a year it has traces of wear on the print - but the bag is pristine quality. I like the LV look-alike print - even while it is clearly marked with Vandel logo.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 7, 2026
